(c) Convert the logits vector to a 2D pattern, where the cell in index (op1, op2) is the logit of the result token of applying the operator to (op1, op2) (i.e. op1 + op2). (d) Multiply both patterns element-wise, to get the effective logit contribution of the neuron to the correct answer token for each prompt. (e) Extract the prompts that activate the neuron the most from the activation pattern. (f) Create a list of prompts associated with the tested heuristic.
